article.statement: Let Γ be a Coxeter diagram, J⊆Γ₀, BH(J) its Brink–Howlett groupoid, and I,K associates of J. Any two standard expressions of w∈Hom_BH(I,K) are related by a sequence of atomic braid relations. Preserve the arbitrary-Coxeter-type scope: neither W, W_J, nor the enlarged parabolics W_{I∪{a}} are globally assumed finite. Standard expressions and atomic braid relations have exactly the meanings of Definitions 4.9 and 4.18.
article.locator: Theorem 1.4, printed p. 3; Theorem 4.21 and Remark 4.22, printed p. 20; Definitions 4.9 and 4.18, printed pp. 17 and 19.

portal.statement: For a Coxeter system without rank or type restriction, arbitrary J and associates I,K, any two finite length-additive elementary expressions of the same morphism w:I→K are connected by finitely many atomic braid relations. The finite relative-root condition needed for a two-generator relation is derived from the common prefixes; it is not added as a hypothesis of the main theorem.
portal.locator: Statement, Facts & Assumptions and External input of thm-atomic-matsumoto-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Tits cone intersection and relative arrangement

article.statement: For J ⊆ Γ₀, let Θ_J = {f ∈ V*: f(α_j)=0 for every j∈J}. Define Cone(J)=Cone∩Θ_J, taking its interior in Θ_J. Define Φ^J={α∈Φ: Θ_J is not contained in H_α}=Φ\Φ_J and H^J={H_α∩Θ_J: α∈Φ^J_+}, counting coincident traces once.
article.locator: §3.1, printed p. 7, equations (3.1)–(3.3); §1.1.2, printed p. 2.

portal.statement: The same relative cone, roots and distinct hyperplane traces, explicitly using finite Γ₀ and the induced coordinate Euclidean topology. Neither W nor W_J is required to be finite.
portal.locator: Definition and Source notes of def-relative-cone-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Local finiteness in the relative interior

article.statement: Every u∈Cone(J)° belongs to an open ball in Cone(J) meeting only finitely many members of H^J. Consequently (Cone(J)°,H^J) is locally finite.
article.locator: Proposition 3.6, printed p. 9; Remark 3.7 distinguishes this from ambient local finiteness.

portal.statement: For finite Γ₀ and arbitrary J, every point of the relative interior has a relative Euclidean ball contained in Cone(J) meeting finitely many distinct relative hyperplanes. No spherical-type hypothesis is imposed.

items.title: Minimal coset labels classify relative chambers

article.statement: The map (x,I)↦xC_I bijects the chambers of (Cone(J)°,H^J) with Cham(J)={(x,I): W_Jx=xW_I and x has minimum length in xW_I}. Here C_I={f∈Θ_I: f(α_i)>0 for i∉I}.
article.locator: Theorem 3.9 and equation (3.10), printed pp. 9–10; equation (3.2), printed p. 7.

portal.statement: The same chamber-labelling bijection under the finite-rank geometric convention, for arbitrary Coxeter type and arbitrary J. The algebraic label set itself is available at arbitrary rank.
portal.locator: Statement, Facts & Assumptions and Source notes of thm-chamber-labelling-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Elementary crossing elements from spherical components

article.statement: For a∉I, let D=[I,a] be the component containing a in the diagram induced on I∪{a}. When W_D is finite, define v_{a,I}=w_{D\{a}}w_D, K=(I∪{a})\{ι_D(a)}, and ω_{a,I}(x,I)=(xv_{a,I},K). The opposition permutation satisfies w_Dα_i=−α_{ι_D(i)}. Finiteness is required of W_D, not of W_I or W_{I∪{a}}.
article.locator: Notation 3.13 and equations (3.14)–(3.15), printed p. 10; Notation 2.5 and equation (2.6), printed p. 5.

portal.statement: The same component-based construction on algebraic labels. Its definition initially gives a pair in W×P(Γ₀); preservation of chamber labels and geometric adjacency require subsequent results.

items.title: Adjacent chambers and inverse elementary crossings

article.statement: For adjacent chambers (x,I),(y,K), the common wall has unique describing indices a∉I and a′∉K, with I∪{a}=K∪{a′}. Their crossing components coincide and are spherical. The crossings satisfy ω_{a,I}(x,I)=(y,K), ω_{a′,K}(y,K)=(x,I), and v_{a,I}v_{a′,K}=v_{a′,K}v_{a,I}=1.
article.locator: Proposition 3.17 and following sentence, printed p. 11.

portal.statement: In finite rank, the common closed wall is the closure of xC_{I∪{a}} and of yC_{K∪{a′}}. The describing indices, finite crossing components, prescribed opposite labels and inverse products have the stated properties. Neither W_I nor W_{I∪{a}} is assumed finite.

items.title: Finite crossing paths connect relative chambers

article.statement: Any two chambers are related by a finite sequence of simple wall crossings.
article.locator: Lemma 3.20(3) and Remark 3.22, printed p. 11; Remark 3.8, printed p. 9.

portal.statement: For a finite-rank Coxeter system and arbitrary J, any two relative chambers are joined by finitely many component-based simple crossings. The empty sequence is allowed for equal endpoints.

items.title: Free normaliser-quotient action on chamber labels

article.statement: For ḡ∈N(W,J)=Norm_W(W_J)/W_J and any representative g, let y be the minimum-length element of gxW_I. Then ḡ·(x,I)=(y,I). Labels with the same second component form one orbit; the action is free and commutes with each defined adjacent crossing ω_{a,I}, preserving its index.
article.locator: Lemma 3.24(1)–(4), printed p. 12; underlying linear action in Lemma 3.23, printed p. 12.

portal.statement: The same free action, fibre-orbit description and crossing equivariance in the finite-rank relative chamber geometry, without requiring W or W_J finite.

items.title: Geodesicity equals Coxeter-length additivity

article.statement: For a chamber path p with consecutive crossing elements v₁,…,v_m and product v_p, p is geodesic if and only if ℓ(v_p)=Σ_i ℓ(v_i). Geodesic means having the minimum number of crossings between its endpoints.
article.locator: Proposition 3.29, printed pp. 13–14; path and geodesic conventions in §3.4, printed p. 13.

portal.statement: The same equivalence for finite-rank relative chamber paths, including the one-chamber path with empty product and sum. Its suppliers include the length/half-space criterion and translation between relative arrangements.

items.title: Brink–Howlett groupoid with the article's composition convention

article.statement: Fix a Coxeter diagram Γ, its Coxeter group W and J⊆Γ₀. An associate I of J has W_I conjugate to W_J. The groupoid BH(J) has these associates as objects and Hom_BH(I,K)={x∈W: x{α_k:k∈K}={α_i:i∈I}}. If x:I→K and y:K→L, their left-to-right composite is xy:I→L.
article.locator: §4.1, definition preceding Remark 4.1, printed p. 15; associates in Definition 2.7, printed p. 5.

portal.statement: The same small connected groupoid, with arrows tagged by source and target and multiplication read left to right. No finite-rank or spherical-type restriction is imposed.

items.title: Elementary crossings are Brink–Howlett arrows

article.statement: If I is an associate of J, a∉I and W_[I,a] is finite, then v_{a,I}∈Hom_BH(I,(I∪{a})\{ι_[I,a](a)}).
article.locator: Lemma 4.2, printed p. 15.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, the prescribed target K is an associate of J and v_{a,I}{α_k:k∈K}={α_i:i∈I}. Only the crossing component is required to be spherical.

items.title: Singleton-arrow groupoid on chamber labels

article.statement: The groupoid BH̃(J) has objects Cham(J), with Hom((x,I),(y,K)) the singleton labelled x⁻¹y. Composition multiplies labels on the right. For adjacent chambers its arrow is labelled by their elementary crossing element.
article.locator: Definition 4.3 and following paragraph, printed p. 15.

portal.statement: The algebraic singleton-arrow construction applies at arbitrary rank, retaining endpoint tags. Its geometric chamber and adjacent-crossing interpretation additionally uses finite rank, without assuming W, W_I or W_{I∪{a}} finite.

items.title: Adjacent crossings generate the universal wall groupoid

article.statement: For any chamber labels (x,I),(y,K), there is a finite crossing path p between them whose product v_p equals x⁻¹y. Thus the adjacent-crossing arrows generate BH̃(J). The path need not be unique.
article.locator: Proposition 4.4, printed p. 16.

portal.statement: The same factorization through finite paths in the finite-rank relative-interior arrangement, with endpoint-tagged arrows and the zero-crossing case included.

items.title: Chamber labels and prescribed-source arrow lifting

article.statement: For associates I,K of J: (1) chamber labels (x,I),(y,K) satisfy x⁻¹y∈Hom_BH(I,K); (2) if w∈Hom_BH(I,K) and (x,I)∈Cham(J), then (xw,K)∈Cham(J), and w labels the arrow upstairs from (x,I) to (xw,K).
article.locator: Proposition 4.6(1)–(2), printed p. 16.

portal.statement: The same assertions are stated with finite-rank hypotheses and geometric chamber identification. The main covering entry separately supplies an arbitrary-rank algebraic correspondence using canonical simple systems.

items.title: Theorem 1.3 / 4.7: universal covering, wall crossings and deck quotient

article.statement: Let Γ be a Coxeter diagram with Coxeter group W and J⊆Γ₀. The functor F:BH̃(J)→BH(J), defined by F(x,I)=I and F(x⁻¹y)=x⁻¹y, is a universal groupoid covering with Deck(F)≅N(W,J). Preserve also Theorem 1.3's geometric content: its upstairs objects are the chambers of (Cone(J)°,H^J), its generating morphisms are simple crossings between adjacent chambers, and BH(J) is obtained as the N(W,J)-quotient of BH̃(J). No spherical-type restriction on W or W_J is stated.
article.locator: Theorem 1.3 and following paragraph, printed p. 2; Theorem 4.7, printed pp. 16–17; Definition 4.3, printed p. 15; Proposition 4.4, printed p. 16.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, the algebraic label groupoid covers BH(J) universally, has deck group N(W,J), and has quotient isomorphic to BH(J). Its geometric chamber identification, adjacent-generator interpretation and generation assertion explicitly use finite rank. Neither W nor W_J is required finite. This scope distinction remains explicit and is not substituted for the original requested statement.
portal.locator: Statement, External input and Source notes of thm-universal-brink-howlett-cover-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Length-additive elementary expressions

article.statement: For w∈Hom_BH(I,K), a standard expression is a finite composable product w=v_{a₁,I₁}⋯v_{a_m,I_m}, starting at I and ending at K, with ℓ(w)=Σ_iℓ(v_{a_i,I_i}). Its expression length is m. Existence and independence of the expression are subsequent assertions, not assumptions of this definition.
article.locator: Definition 4.9, printed p. 17.

portal.statement: The same definition at arbitrary rank. Each elementary factor requires its crossing component spherical. The empty expression represents an identity. The notation ℓ_BH(w) is introduced only after existence and invariance of factor count are established.

items.title: Standard expressions lift to geodesic paths

article.statement: A composable sequence of simple wall crossings is a geodesic path exactly when its product is a standard expression in BH. Every w∈Hom_BH(I,K) has a standard expression; its lift from (x,I) ends at (xw,K).
article.locator: Lemma 4.10 and equations (4.11)–(4.12), printed p. 18.

portal.statement: In finite rank, each standard expression has a unique geodesic lift from any prescribed chamber of its source type. For specified crossings, target-source compatibility is required. The empty expression corresponds to a one-chamber path. This geometric supplier alone does not establish arbitrary-rank existence.

items.title: Arbitrary-rank existence and parallel-class factor count

article.statement: No standalone article statement gives the parallel-class formula selected here. This is a portal helper supporting existence of standard expressions and invariance of their factor count; the parent article assertions are Lemma 4.10 and Corollary 4.13.
article.locator: Parent results: Lemma 4.10 and Corollary 4.13, printed p. 18. The formula m=|C(w)| is not attributed to an article lemma.

portal.statement: Every article morphism w has a standard expression. If an expression has m factors, then m=|C(w)|, using the opposite root-action arrow with the same label. Here C(w) is the finite set of real parallel classes contained in its positive inversion set. Its declared algebraic suppliers allow arbitrary rank.
portal.locator: Statement and Facts & Assumptions of lem-author-b19d43a8e520-bh-standard-factor-count; source references are empty, so article attribution is only through the stated parent results.

items.title: Elementary generation and invariance of standard length

article.statement: BH(J) is generated by v_{a,I} for associates I and a∉I with W_[I,a] finite. Any two standard expressions of the same morphism, with the same source, have the same number of factors.
article.locator: Corollary 4.13(1)–(2), printed p. 18.

portal.statement: The same generation and equal-factor-count assertions. Its current proof suppliers use the arbitrary-rank StandardFactorCount endpoint rather than relying on finite-rank chamber geometry.

items.title: Finite relative longest element inside an arbitrary system

article.statement: No standalone article lemma states this full construction and inversion-set formula. It is a portal helper for Lemma 4.15: finite Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I allows construction inside the union of the components meeting {a,b}, without making I or the ambient system spherical.
article.locator: Parent result: Lemma 4.15 and equation (4.16), printed p. 19; related inverse characterization in Remark 4.17, printed p. 19.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, let a,b∉I be distinct, T=I∪{a,b}, and Φ_T\Φ_I finite. Let D be the union of components of T meeting {a,b}. Then W_D is finite. For r=w_Dw_{D∩I}, rΠ_I=Π_K for an associate K⊆T; q=r⁻¹ is an article morphism I→K and N(q)=Φ_T⁺\Φ_I⁺, where N(x)=Φ⁺∩xΦ⁻.

items.title: Minimal common prefix and its two standard expressions

article.statement: Let I be an associate of J and a,b∉I distinct, with |Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I|<∞. There is an associate K and v_{a,b,I}:I→K left-divisible by v_{a,I},v_{b,I}, with exactly two standard expressions of equal factor count, starting respectively with these generators. Every BH morphism from I having both generators as length-additive left divisors has v_{a,b,I} as a left divisor. Thus this common multiple is minimal for left divisibility and standard-expression length.
article.locator: Lemma 4.15(1)–(2) and equation (4.16), printed p. 19.

portal.statement: The same theorem with its finite relative-root hypothesis retained. It chooses v_{a,b,I}=(w_Dw_{D∩I})⁻¹ using FiniteRelativeLongest. The declared supporting endpoints separately establish elementary prefixes, simultaneous-prefix minimality and exactly two standard words.

items.title: Atomic braid relations and contextual replacements

article.statement: Under Lemma 4.15's hypotheses, equating the two standard expressions of v_{a,b,I} in (4.16) is an atomic braid relation.
article.locator: Definition 4.18, Lemma 4.15 and equation (4.16), printed p. 19.

portal.statement: For distinct a,b outside an associate I with finite Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I, the equality of the two supplied standard expressions defines the atomic braid relation. In the main theorem a move replaces either side inside a composable expression, retaining the surrounding factors.
portal.locator: Definition of def-atomic-braid-artin-tits-normalisers; contextual use in the Statement of thm-atomic-matsumoto-artin-tits-normalisers.

article.locator: Theorem 1.4, printed p. 3; Theorem 4.21 and Remark 4.22, printed p. 20; Definitions 4.9 and 4.18, printed pp. 17 and 19.

Root signs, root stability and positivity under simple reflection away from its own root. Supplies the proved inversion-finiteness induction. No rank or spherical-type assumption. Inspected local source and verified unchanged at observed HEAD 1bdd7a76d6447fe84bc46aab09120f20292bf334. Complete direct inventory for this module.

    SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2

import Proofs.AtomicBraidRelations

-- Local implementation contract for Theorem 4.21, printed p.20.
-- It is not attributed as a standalone article theorem.
def CommonPrefixFinite {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) : Prop :=
  let Obj := {L : Set S // ∃ g : W,
    (cs.parabolic L).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J}
  let component := fun (L : Set S) (c : S) =>
    {d | d ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) c d}
  let parabolicRoots := fun (L : Set S) =>
    {α | ∃ u : W, u ∈ cs.parabolic L ∧ ∃ i ∈ L,
      cs.geometricRepresentation u (Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) = α}
  let leftDiv := fun u v : W => cs.length v = cs.length u + cs.length (u⁻¹ * v)
  ∀ (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ I.val) (hb : b ∉ I.val), a ≠ b →
    ∀ (hDa : Finite (cs.parabolic (component I.val a)))
      (hDb : Finite (cs.parabolic (component I.val b))),
    leftDiv (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hDa).1 w.val →
    leftDiv (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val b hb hDb).1 w.val →
    Set.Finite (parabolicRoots (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) \ parabolicRoots I.val)

      rcases cs.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots

      · exact hneg
    exact ⟨hr, hp, hneg⟩

  have finiteInv (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (w : W) :
      Set.Finite {α | α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < α ∧ cs.geometricRepresentation w α < 0} := by
    classical
    induction w using cs.simple_induction_right with
    | one =>
      have he : {α | α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < α ∧ cs.geometricRepresentation (1 : W) α < 0} = ∅ := by
        ext α

        rintro ⟨_, hp, hn⟩
        exact (lt_asymm hp hn)
      rw [he]
      exact Set.finite_empty
    | mul_simple_right w i ih =>
      apply ((ih.image (M.geometricReflection i)).union (Set.finite_singleton (Finsupp.single i 1))).subset
      intro α hα
      by_cases he : α = Finsupp.single i 1
      · exact Or.inr he

        refine ⟨M.geometricReflection i α, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · exact (cs.geometricReflection_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff i).mpr hα.1
        · exact cs.geometricReflection_pos_of_mem_geometricRoots hα.1 hα.2.1 he

  have hposfin : Set.Finite
      {x | x ∈ parabolicRoots (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) ∧
        x ∉ parabolicRoots I.val ∧ 0 < x} :=
    (finiteInv cs w.val⁻¹).subset positive_inclusion
  have root_neg (L : Set S) (x : S →₀ ℝ) (hx : x ∈ parabolicRoots L) :
      -x ∈ parabolicRoots L := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu, i, hi, he⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨u * cs.simple i, mul_mem hu (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi), i, hi, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple,
      M.geometricReflection_apply_single_self, map_neg, he]
  apply (hposfin.union (hposfin.image (fun x => -x))).subset
  rintro x ⟨hxT, hxI⟩
  have hr : x ∈ cs.geometricRoots := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu, i, hi, he⟩ := hxT
    exact ⟨u, i, he⟩
  rcases cs.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr with hp | hn
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hxT, hxI, hp⟩
  · apply Or.inr
    refine ⟨-x, ⟨root_neg _ _ hxT, ?_, neg_pos.mpr hn⟩, neg_neg x⟩
    intro hh
    exact hxI (by simpa only [neg_neg] using root_neg _ _ hh)

import ArtinDeligne
import Proofs.AtomicBraidRelations

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

/- Local implementation calculus for Theorem 4.21, printed p.20:
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.21915#page=20
Alphabeta inspiration: parent proof steps 2.1 and 4.1, and Facts [F4]:
https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-thm-atomic-matsumoto-artin-tits-normalisers
Concatenation is Remark 4.14, printed p.18. These local list routines have
no original standalone article statements and create no prerequisite item.
The supplied historical Interfaces.lean was unavailable; this namespace
records explicit definitions of the three described clauses for handoff.
-/
namespace RecoveredAtomicWork

variable {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}

abbrev Obj (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { L : Set S // ∃ g : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g))
    (cs.parabolic L) = cs.parabolic J }

def component (L : Set S) (a : S) : Set S :=
  { b | b ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }

abbrev Atom (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { p : Obj cs J × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧ Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) p.1.val p.2)) }

noncomputable def crossing (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (t : Atom cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs t.val.1.val t.val.2 t.property.1 t.property.2

noncomputable def Comp (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (es : List (Atom cs J)) (I K : Set S) : Prop :=
  List.foldr (fun t tail L => L = t.val.1.val ∧ tail (crossing cs J t).2.1)
    (fun L => L = K) es I

noncomputable def word (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) : W :=
  (es.map (fun t => (crossing cs J t).1)).prod

noncomputable def weight (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) : Nat :=
  (es.map (fun t => cs.length (crossing cs J t).1)).sum

variable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)

lemma word_length_le (es : List (Atom cs J)) : cs.length (word cs J es) ≤ weight cs J es := by
  induction es with
  | nil => simp [word, weight, cs.length_one]
  | cons t es ih =>
    change cs.length ((crossing cs J t).1 * word cs J es) ≤
      cs.length (crossing cs J t).1 + weight cs J es
    exact (cs.length_mul_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _)

lemma comp_append (es fs : List (Atom cs J)) (L F G : Set S)
    (hes : Comp cs J es L F) (hfs : Comp cs J fs F G) :
    Comp cs J (es ++ fs) L G := by
  induction es generalizing L with
  | nil =>
    change L = F at hes
    subst L
    exact hfs
  | cons e es ih => exact ⟨hes.1, ih _ hes.2⟩

/- Steps 2.1 and 4.1: extract a typed residual arrow. Its source is the
prescribed crossing target. The whole-word equality and the triangle
inequality force tail additivity; no tail additivity premise is used. -/
lemma suffix (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t : Atom cs J) (es : List (Atom cs J))
    (he : e.val = t :: es) :
    ∃ (L : Obj cs J) (z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K),
      L.val = (crossing cs J t).2.1 ∧
      z.val = (crossing cs J t).1⁻¹ * w.val ∧
      ∃ ez : StandardExpressions cs J L K z, ez.val = es := by
  have hc : Comp cs J (t :: es) I.val K.val := by
    have hc0 : Comp cs J e.val I.val K.val := e.property.1
    rw [he] at hc0
    exact hc0
  have hp : (crossing cs J t).1 * word cs J es = w.val := by
    have hp0 : word cs J e.val = w.val := e.property.2.1
    rw [he] at hp0
    exact hp0
  have hl : cs.length w.val = cs.length (crossing cs J t).1 + weight cs J es := by
    have hl0 : cs.length w.val = weight cs J e.val := e.property.2.2
    rw [he] at hl0
    exact hl0
  have hI : I = t.val.1 := Subtype.ext hc.1
  obtain ⟨hL, v0, hv0⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J t.val.1.val
    t.val.1.property t.val.2 t.property.1 t.property.2
  let L : Obj cs J := ⟨(crossing cs J t).2.1, hL⟩
  let v : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I L := by
    cases hI
    exact v0
  have hv : v.val = (crossing cs J t).1 := by
    cases hI
    exact hv0
  let z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K :=
    (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv v) w
  have hz : z.val = (crossing cs J t).1⁻¹ * w.val := by
    change v.val⁻¹ * w.val = _
    rw [hv]
  have hzp : z.val = word cs J es := by rw [hz, ← hp, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  have hle := word_length_le cs J es
  have htri := cs.length_mul_le (crossing cs J t).1 (word cs J es)
  rw [hp] at htri
  have htail : cs.length z.val = weight cs J es := by
    rw [hzp]
    omega
  refine ⟨L, z, rfl, hz, ⟨es, ?_, hzp.symm, htail⟩, rfl⟩
  exact hc.2

/- Same head means the same target object and the same residual label.
Proof-irrelevant subtype equality handles the dependent arrow type. -/
lemma same_head (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (e f : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t : Atom cs J)
    (es fs : List (Atom cs J)) (he : e.val = t :: es) (hf : f.val = t :: fs) :
    ∃ (L : Obj cs J) (z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K)
      (ez fz : StandardExpressions cs J L K z), ez.val = es ∧ fz.val = fs := by
  obtain ⟨L, z, hL, hz, ez, hez⟩ := suffix cs J I K w e t es he
  obtain ⟨L', z', hL', hz', fz, hfz⟩ := suffix cs J I K w f t fs hf
  have hLL : L' = L := Subtype.ext (hL'.trans hL.symm)
  subst L'
  have hzz : z' = z := Subtype.ext (hz'.trans hz.symm)
  subst z'
  exact ⟨L, z, ez, fz, hez, hfz⟩

/- Remark 4.14; the endpoint-threading routine above reuses the completed
Proofs/TwoGeneratorMinimal.lean comp_append block (lines 1875ff). -/
lemma concatenate (I L K : Obj cs J)
    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I L)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K)
    (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (ex : StandardExpressions cs J I L x) (ey : StandardExpressions cs J L K y)
    (hp : x.val * y.val = w.val)
    (hl : cs.length w.val = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val) :
    ∃ ew : StandardExpressions cs J I K w, ew.val = ex.val ++ ey.val := by
  refine ⟨⟨ex.val ++ ey.val, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact comp_append cs J ex.val ey.val I.val L.val K.val ex.property.1 ey.property.1
  · simpa only [List.map_append, List.prod_append, ex.property.2.1, ey.property.2.1] using hp
  · simpa only [List.map_append, List.sum_append, ← ex.property.2.2, ← ey.property.2.2] using hl

lemma head_prefix (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t : Atom cs J) (es : List (Atom cs J))
    (he : e.val = t :: es) :
    I = t.val.1 ∧ cs.length w.val = cs.length (crossing cs J t).1 +
      cs.length ((crossing cs J t).1⁻¹ * w.val) := by
  have hc : Comp cs J (t :: es) I.val K.val := by
    have hc0 : Comp cs J e.val I.val K.val := e.property.1
    rw [he] at hc0
    exact hc0
  obtain ⟨L, z, _, hz, ez, hez⟩ := suffix cs J I K w e t es he
  have hl : cs.length w.val = cs.length (crossing cs J t).1 + weight cs J es := by
    have hl0 : cs.length w.val = weight cs J e.val := e.property.2.2
    rw [he] at hl0
    exact hl0
  have htail : cs.length z.val = weight cs J es := by
    have htail0 : cs.length z.val = weight cs J ez.val := ez.property.2.2
    rw [hez] at htail0
    exact htail0
  exact ⟨Subtype.ext hc.1, by rw [← hz, htail]; exact hl⟩

/- This conjunction states the three task-described clauses explicitly.
It is not represented as the absent historical AtomicWork.ExpressionCalculus. -/
theorem expression_calculus :
    (∀ (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (e f : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t : Atom cs J)
      (es fs : List (Atom cs J)), e.val = t :: es → f.val = t :: fs →
      ∃ (L : Obj cs J) (z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K)
        (ez fz : StandardExpressions cs J L K z), ez.val = es ∧ fz.val = fs) ∧
    (∀ (I L K : Obj cs J)
      (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I L)
      (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K)
      (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (ex : StandardExpressions cs J I L x) (ey : StandardExpressions cs J L K y),
      x.val * y.val = w.val →
      cs.length w.val = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val →
      ∃ ew : StandardExpressions cs J I K w, ew.val = ex.val ++ ey.val) ∧
    (∀ (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t : Atom cs J) (es : List (Atom cs J)),
      e.val = t :: es → I = t.val.1 ∧
      cs.length w.val = cs.length (crossing cs J t).1 +
        cs.length ((crossing cs J t).1⁻¹ * w.val)) :=
  ⟨same_head cs J, concatenate cs J, head_prefix cs J⟩

end RecoveredAtomicWork

#print axioms RecoveredAtomicWork.same_head
#print axioms RecoveredAtomicWork.concatenate
#print axioms RecoveredAtomicWork.head_prefix

#print axioms RecoveredAtomicWork.expression_calculus

noncomputable abbrev crossing (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (t : Atom cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs t.val.1.val t.val.2 t.property.1 t.property.2
abbrev leftDiv (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (u v : W) :=
  cs.length v = cs.length u + cs.length (u⁻¹ * v)
abbrev parabolicRoots (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (L : Set S) : Set (S →₀ ℝ) :=
  {α | ∃ u : W, u ∈ cs.parabolic L ∧ ∃ i : S, i ∈ L ∧ cs.geometricRepresentation u (Finsupp.single i 1) = α}

theorem selectedBridge (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)

    (t s : Atom cs J) (ht : t.val.1 = I) (hs : s.val.1 = I)
    (hab : t.val.2 ≠ s.val.2)
    (hfin : Set.Finite (parabolicRoots cs (Set.insert t.val.2 (Set.insert s.val.2 I.val)) \ parabolicRoots cs I.val))
    (hpt : leftDiv cs (crossing cs J t).1 w.val)
    (hps : leftDiv cs (crossing cs J s).1 w.val)
    (cat : ∀ (H : Obj cs J) (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I H)
      (z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom H K)
      (eq : StandardExpressions cs J I H q) (ez : StandardExpressions cs J H K z),
      q.val * z.val = w.val → cs.length w.val = cs.length q.val + cs.length z.val →
      ∃ g : StandardExpressions cs J I K w, g.val = eq.val ++ ez.val) :
    ∃ (g h : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (gs hs : List (Atom cs J)),

  have ha : t.val.2 ∉ I.val := by simpa only [ht] using t.property.1
  have hb : s.val.2 ∉ I.val := by simpa only [hs] using s.property.1

  let h1 := Classical.choose_spec h0
  let hDb := Classical.choose h1
  let h2 := Classical.choose_spec h1
  let H := Classical.choose h2
  let h3 := Classical.choose_spec h2
  let q := Classical.choose h3
  let h4 := Classical.choose_spec h3
  let ea := Classical.choose h4
  let eb := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec h4)
  have spec := Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec h4)

    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext ht.symm rfl
  have hsb : (⟨(I, s.val.2), ⟨hb, hDb⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) = s := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext hs.symm rfl

    change leftDiv cs (crossing cs J (⟨(I,t.val.2),⟨ha,hDa⟩⟩ : Atom cs J)).1 w.val
    rw [hta]
    exact hpt

    change leftDiv cs (crossing cs J (⟨(I,s.val.2),⟨hb,hDb⟩⟩ : Atom cs J)).1 w.val
    rw [hsb]

  have hz : z.val = q.val⁻¹ * w.val := rfl
  obtain ⟨ez⟩ := (StandardFactorCount cs J H K z).1
  have hmul : q.val * z.val = w.val := by rw [hz]; exact mul_inv_cancel_left _ _
  have hlen : cs.length w.val = cs.length q.val + cs.length z.val := by
    rw [hz]; exact hqw

  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := cat H q z eb ez hmul hlen

  obtain ⟨tb, heb⟩ := spec.2.2.2.2.2.2.1

  have heb' : eb.val = s :: tb := Eq.trans heb (congrArg (fun x : Atom cs J => x :: tb) hsb)
  refine ⟨g, h, ta ++ ez.val, tb ++ ez.val, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hg, hea']; rfl
  · rw [hh, heb']; rfl
  · refine ⟨[], ea.val, eb.val, ez.val, ?_, ?_, ?_, I, K, g.property.1, h.property.1⟩
    · refine ⟨I, t.val.2, s.val.2, ha, hb, hab, hfin, ?_⟩
      exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact hg
    · exact hh

-- The referenced AtomicWork interface file was unavailable in this workspace;
-- these clause types do not claim to reproduce that missing file byte-for-byte.
theorem bridgeFromLocalClauses (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (commonPrefixFinite : ∀ (I K : Obj cs J)
      (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K) (t s : Atom cs J),
      t.val.1 = I → s.val.1 = I → t.val.2 ≠ s.val.2 →
      leftDiv cs (crossing cs J t).1 w.val → leftDiv cs (crossing cs J s).1 w.val →
      Set.Finite (parabolicRoots cs (Set.insert t.val.2 (Set.insert s.val.2 I.val)) \ parabolicRoots cs I.val))
    (expressionConcatenation : ∀ (I H K : Obj cs J)
      (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I H)
      (z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom H K)
      (eq : StandardExpressions cs J I H q) (ez : StandardExpressions cs J H K z),
      q.val * z.val = w.val → cs.length w.val = cs.length q.val + cs.length z.val →
      ∃ g : StandardExpressions cs J I K w, g.val = eq.val ++ ez.val)
    (expressionHead : ∀ (I K : Obj cs J)
      (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t : Atom cs J) (es : List (Atom cs J)),
      e.val = t :: es → t.val.1 = I ∧ leftDiv cs (crossing cs J t).1 w.val)
    (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (e f : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t s : Atom cs J)
    (es fs : List (Atom cs J)) (he : e.val = t :: es) (hf : f.val = s :: fs)
    (hab : t.val.2 ≠ s.val.2) :
    ∃ (g h : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (gs hs : List (Atom cs J)),
      g.val = t :: gs ∧ h.val = s :: hs ∧ AtomicBraidRelations cs J g.val h.val := by
  obtain ⟨ht, hpt⟩ := expressionHead I K w e t es he
  obtain ⟨hs, hps⟩ := expressionHead I K w f s fs hf
  -- Step 3.1: relative-root finiteness comes from the explicit pending local block.
  have hfin := commonPrefixFinite I K w t s ht hs hab hpt hps
  exact selectedBridge cs J I K w t s ht hs hab hfin hpt hps
    (fun H q z eq ez => expressionConcatenation I H K w q z eq ez)

#print axioms bridgeFromLocalClauses
end BridgeWork

      refine ⟨u * cs.simple i, mul_mem hu (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi), i, hi, ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple,
        M.geometricReflection_apply_single_self, map_neg, he]
    apply (hposfin.union (hposfin.image (fun x => -x))).subset
    rintro x ⟨hxT, hxI⟩
    have hr : x ∈ cs.geometricRoots := by
      obtain ⟨u, hu, i, hi, he⟩ := hxT
      exact ⟨u, i, he⟩
    rcases cs.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr with hp | hn
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hxT, hxI, hp⟩
    · apply Or.inr
      refine ⟨-x, ⟨root_neg _ _ hxT, ?_, neg_pos.mpr hn⟩, neg_neg x⟩
      intro hh
      exact hxI (by simpa only [neg_neg] using root_neg _ _ hh)

  let Obj := { L : Set S // ∃ g : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g))
      (cs.parabolic L) = cs.parabolic J }
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun L a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Atom := { p : Obj × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧ Finite (cs.parabolic (component p.1.val p.2)) }
  let crossing := fun t : Atom => SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs t.val.1.val t.val.2 t.property.1 t.property.2
  let Comp := fun (es : List Atom) (I K : Set S) =>
    List.foldr (fun t tail L => L = t.val.1.val ∧ tail (crossing t).2.1) (fun L => L = K) es I
  let word := fun es : List Atom => (es.map (fun t => (crossing t).1)).prod
  let weight := fun es : List Atom => (es.map (fun t => cs.length (crossing t).1)).sum
  let leftDiv := fun u v : W => cs.length v = cs.length u + cs.length (u⁻¹ * v)
  let parabolicRoots := fun L : Set S => {α | ∃ u : W, u ∈ cs.parabolic L ∧ ∃ i : S, i ∈ L ∧ cs.geometricRepresentation u (Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) = α}
  have word_length_le (es : List (Atom)) : cs.length (word es) ≤ weight es := by
    induction es with
    | nil => simp [word, weight, cs.length_one]
    | cons t es ih =>
      change cs.length ((crossing t).1 * word es) ≤
        cs.length (crossing t).1 + weight es
      exact (cs.length_mul_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _)
  
  have comp_append (es fs : List (Atom)) (L F G : Set S)
      (hes : Comp es L F) (hfs : Comp fs F G) :
      Comp (es ++ fs) L G := by
    induction es generalizing L with
    | nil =>
      change L = F at hes
      subst L
      exact hfs
    | cons e es ih => exact ⟨hes.1, ih _ hes.2⟩
  
  /- Steps 2.1 and 4.1: extract a typed residual arrow. Its source is the
  prescribed crossing target. The whole-word equality and the triangle
  inequality force tail additivity; no tail additivity premise is used. -/
  have suffix (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t : Atom) (es : List (Atom))
      (he : e.val = t :: es) :
      ∃ (L : Obj) (z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K),
        L.val = (crossing t).2.1 ∧
        z.val = (crossing t).1⁻¹ * w.val ∧
        ∃ ez : StandardExpressions cs J L K z, ez.val = es := by
    have hc : Comp (t :: es) I.val K.val := by
      have hc0 : Comp e.val I.val K.val := e.property.1
      rw [he] at hc0
      exact hc0
    have hp : (crossing t).1 * word es = w.val := by
      have hp0 : word e.val = w.val := e.property.2.1
      rw [he] at hp0
      exact hp0
    have hl : cs.length w.val = cs.length (crossing t).1 + weight es := by
      have hl0 : cs.length w.val = weight e.val := e.property.2.2
      rw [he] at hl0
      exact hl0
    have hI : I = t.val.1 := Subtype.ext hc.1
    obtain ⟨hL, v0, hv0⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J t.val.1.val
      t.val.1.property t.val.2 t.property.1 t.property.2
    let L : Obj := ⟨(crossing t).2.1, hL⟩
    let v : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I L := by
      cases hI
      exact v0
    have hv : v.val = (crossing t).1 := by
      cases hI
      exact hv0
    let z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K :=
      (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv v) w
    have hz : z.val = (crossing t).1⁻¹ * w.val := by
      change v.val⁻¹ * w.val = _
      rw [hv]
    have hzp : z.val = word es := by rw [hz, ← hp, inv_mul_cancel_left]
    have hle := word_length_le es
    have htri := cs.length_mul_le (crossing t).1 (word es)
    rw [hp] at htri
    have htail : cs.length z.val = weight es := by
      rw [hzp]
      omega
    refine ⟨L, z, rfl, hz, ⟨es, ?_, hzp.symm, htail⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hc.2
  
  /- Same head means the same target object and the same residual label.
  Proof-irrelevant subtype equality handles the dependent arrow type. -/
  have same_head (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (e f : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t : Atom)
      (es fs : List (Atom)) (he : e.val = t :: es) (hf : f.val = t :: fs) :
      ∃ (L : Obj) (z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K)
        (ez fz : StandardExpressions cs J L K z), ez.val = es ∧ fz.val = fs := by
    obtain ⟨L, z, hL, hz, ez, hez⟩ := suffix I K w e t es he
    obtain ⟨L', z', hL', hz', fz, hfz⟩ := suffix I K w f t fs hf
    have hLL : L' = L := Subtype.ext (hL'.trans hL.symm)
    subst L'
    have hzz : z' = z := Subtype.ext (hz'.trans hz.symm)
    subst z'
    exact ⟨L, z, ez, fz, hez, hfz⟩
  
  /- Remark 4.14; the endpoint-threading routine above reuses the completed
  Proofs/TwoGeneratorMinimal.lean comp_append block (lines 1875ff). -/
  have concatenate (I L K : Obj)
      (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I L)
      (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K)
      (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (ex : StandardExpressions cs J I L x) (ey : StandardExpressions cs J L K y)
      (hp : x.val * y.val = w.val)
      (hl : cs.length w.val = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val) :
      ∃ ew : StandardExpressions cs J I K w, ew.val = ex.val ++ ey.val := by
    refine ⟨⟨ex.val ++ ey.val, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact comp_append ex.val ey.val I.val L.val K.val ex.property.1 ey.property.1
    · simpa only [List.map_append, List.prod_append, ex.property.2.1, ey.property.2.1] using hp
    · simpa only [List.map_append, List.sum_append, ← ex.property.2.2, ← ey.property.2.2] using hl
  
  have head_prefix (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (t : Atom) (es : List (Atom))
      (he : e.val = t :: es) :
      I = t.val.1 ∧ cs.length w.val = cs.length (crossing t).1 +
        cs.length ((crossing t).1⁻¹ * w.val) := by
    have hc : Comp (t :: es) I.val K.val := by
      have hc0 : Comp e.val I.val K.val := e.property.1
      rw [he] at hc0
      exact hc0
    obtain ⟨L, z, _, hz, ez, hez⟩ := suffix I K w e t es he
    have hl : cs.length w.val = cs.length (crossing t).1 + weight es := by
      have hl0 : cs.length w.val = weight e.val := e.property.2.2
      rw [he] at hl0
      exact hl0
    have htail : cs.length z.val = weight es := by
      have htail0 : cs.length z.val = weight ez.val := ez.property.2.2
      rw [hez] at htail0
      exact htail0
    exact ⟨Subtype.ext hc.1, by rw [← hz, htail]; exact hl⟩
  
  have liftHead : ∀ (I K : Obj) (t : Atom) (es fs : List Atom),
    Comp (t :: es) I.val K.val → Relation.ReflTransGen (AtomicBraidRelations cs J) es fs → Relation.ReflTransGen (AtomicBraidRelations cs J) (t :: es) (t :: fs) := by
    let Moves := Relation.ReflTransGen (AtomicBraidRelations cs J)
    have appendComp (xs ys : List (Atom)) (A B : Set S) :
        Comp (xs ++ ys) A B ↔
          ∃ C, Comp xs A C ∧ Comp ys C B := by
      induction xs generalizing A with
      | nil =>
        change Comp ys A B ↔ ∃ C, A = C ∧ Comp ys C B
        exact ⟨fun h => ⟨A, rfl, h⟩, fun ⟨C, h, hc⟩ => h.symm ▸ hc⟩
      | cons x xs ih =>
        change (A = x.val.1.val ∧ Comp (xs ++ ys) (crossing x).2.1 B) ↔ _
        rw [ih]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨h, C, hc, hd⟩
          exact ⟨C, ⟨h, hc⟩, hd⟩
        · rintro ⟨C, ⟨h, hc⟩, hd⟩
          exact ⟨h, C, hc, hd⟩
    have targetUnique (xs : List (Atom)) : ∀ A B C,
        Comp xs A B → Comp xs A C → B = C := by
      induction xs with
      | nil =>
        intro A B C h h'
        exact h.symm.trans h'
      | cons x xs ih =>
        intro A B C h h'
        exact ih _ _ _ h.2 h'.2
    have endpoints (xs : List (Atom)) (hn : xs ≠ [])
        (A B C D : Set S) (h : Comp xs A B) (h' : Comp xs C D) :
        A = C ∧ B = D := by
      cases xs with
      | nil => exact (hn rfl).elim
      | cons x xs =>
        exact ⟨h.1.trans h'.1.symm, targetUnique xs _ _ _ h.2 h'.2⟩
    have typedPair (u v : List (Atom)) (L H : Obj)
        (hu : Comp u L.val H.val) (hv : Comp v L.val H.val)
        (hnu : u ≠ []) (hnv : v ≠ []) :
        ∀ A B, Comp u A B ↔ Comp v A B := by
      intro A B
      constructor
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := endpoints u hnu A B L.val H.val h hu
        exact hv
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := endpoints v hnv A B L.val H.val h hv
        exact hu
    have replaceComp (pre u v post : List (Atom))
        (h : ∀ A B, Comp u A B ↔ Comp v A B) (A B : Set S) :
        Comp (pre ++ u ++ post) A B ↔ Comp (pre ++ v ++ post) A B := by
      simp only [appendComp]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨C, ⟨D, hp, hu⟩, ht⟩
        exact ⟨C, ⟨D, hp, (h D C).mp hu⟩, ht⟩
      · rintro ⟨C, ⟨D, hp, hv⟩, ht⟩
        exact ⟨C, ⟨D, hp, (h D C).mpr hv⟩, ht⟩
    have moveComp (es fs : List (Atom)) (hm : AtomicBraidRelations cs J es fs) :
        ∀ A B, Comp es A B ↔ Comp fs A B := by
      obtain ⟨pre, u, v, post, hb, rfl, rfl, _⟩ := hm
      apply replaceComp pre u v post
      obtain ⟨L, a, b, ha, hb, hab, hfin, hpair⟩ := hb
      have h0 := TwoGeneratorMinimal cs J L a b ha hb hab hfin
      let hDa := Classical.choose h0
      have h1 := Classical.choose_spec h0
      let hDb := Classical.choose h1
      have h2 := Classical.choose_spec h1
      let H := Classical.choose h2
      have h3 := Classical.choose_spec h2
      let q := Classical.choose h3
      have h4 := Classical.choose_spec h3
      let ea : StandardExpressions cs J L H q := Classical.choose h4
      let eb : StandardExpressions cs J L H q := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec h4)
      have he := Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec h4)
      have nonemptyPair (xs ys : List (Atom))
          (hne : xs ≠ ys) (hlen : xs.length = ys.length) : xs ≠ [] ∧ ys ≠ [] := by
        constructor
        · intro hx
          have hy : ys = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (hlen.symm.trans (congrArg List.length hx))
          exact hne (hx.trans hy.symm)
        · intro hy
          have hx : xs = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (hlen.trans (congrArg List.length hy))
          exact hne (hx.trans hy.symm)
      have hn := nonemptyPair ea.val eb.val
        (fun h => he.2.2.1 (Subtype.ext h)) he.2.2.2.2.1
      change (u = ea.val ∧ v = eb.val) ∨ (u = eb.val ∧ v = ea.val) at hpair
      rcases hpair with hp | hp
      · intro A B
        rw [hp.1, hp.2]
        exact typedPair ea.val eb.val L H ea.property.1 eb.property.1 hn.1 hn.2 A B
      · intro A B
        rw [hp.1, hp.2]
        exact typedPair eb.val ea.val L H eb.property.1 ea.property.1 hn.2 hn.1 A B
    have liftMove (I K : Obj) (t : Atom) (es fs : List (Atom))
        (hc : Comp (t :: es) I.val K.val)
        (hm : AtomicBraidRelations cs J es fs) :
        AtomicBraidRelations cs J (t :: es) (t :: fs) ∧
          Comp (t :: fs) I.val K.val := by
      have hf : Comp (t :: fs) I.val K.val :=
        ⟨hc.1, (moveComp es fs hm _ _).mp hc.2⟩
      obtain ⟨pre, u, v, post, hb, he, hf', _⟩ := hm
      refine ⟨?_, hf⟩
      refine ⟨t :: pre, u, v, post, hb, ?_, ?_, I, K, hc, hf⟩
      · simpa only [List.cons_append] using congrArg (List.cons t) he
      · simpa only [List.cons_append] using congrArg (List.cons t) hf'
    intro I K t es fs hc hm
    have aux : ∀ {fs}, Moves es fs →
        Moves (t :: es) (t :: fs) ∧ Comp (t :: fs) I.val K.val := by
      intro fs hm
      induction hm with
      | refl => exact ⟨Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, hc⟩
      | @tail ys zs hchain hstep ih =>
        obtain ⟨hlift, hcomp⟩ := liftMove I K t ys zs ih.2 hstep
        exact ⟨ih.1.tail hlift, hcomp⟩
    exact (aux hm).1


  have selectedBridge
      (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (t s : Atom) (ht : t.val.1 = I) (hs : s.val.1 = I)
      (hab : t.val.2 ≠ s.val.2)
      (hfin : Set.Finite (parabolicRoots (Set.insert t.val.2 (Set.insert s.val.2 I.val)) \ parabolicRoots I.val))
      (hpt : leftDiv (crossing t).1 w.val)
      (hps : leftDiv (crossing s).1 w.val)
      (cat : ∀ (H : Obj) (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I H)
        (z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom H K)
        (eq : StandardExpressions cs J I H q) (ez : StandardExpressions cs J H K z),
        q.val * z.val = w.val → cs.length w.val = cs.length q.val + cs.length z.val →
        ∃ g : StandardExpressions cs J I K w, g.val = eq.val ++ ez.val) :
      ∃ (g h : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (gs hs : List (Atom)),
        g.val = t :: gs ∧ h.val = s :: hs ∧ AtomicBraidRelations cs J g.val h.val := by
    classical
    have ha : t.val.2 ∉ I.val := by simpa only [ht] using t.property.1
    have hb : s.val.2 ∉ I.val := by simpa only [hs] using s.property.1
    let h0 := TwoGeneratorMinimal cs J I t.val.2 s.val.2 ha hb hab hfin
    let hDa := Classical.choose h0
    let h1 := Classical.choose_spec h0
    let hDb := Classical.choose h1
    let h2 := Classical.choose_spec h1
    let H := Classical.choose h2
    let h3 := Classical.choose_spec h2
    let q := Classical.choose h3
    let h4 := Classical.choose_spec h3
    let ea := Classical.choose h4
    let eb := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec h4)
    have spec := Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec h4)
    have hta : (⟨(I, t.val.2), ⟨ha, hDa⟩⟩ : Atom) = t := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Prod.ext ht.symm rfl
    have hsb : (⟨(I, s.val.2), ⟨hb, hDb⟩⟩ : Atom) = s := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Prod.ext hs.symm rfl
    have hpt' : leftDiv (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val t.val.2 ha hDa).1 w.val := by
      change leftDiv (crossing (⟨(I,t.val.2),⟨ha,hDa⟩⟩ : Atom)).1 w.val
      rw [hta]
      exact hpt
    have hps' : leftDiv (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val s.val.2 hb hDb).1 w.val := by
      change leftDiv (crossing (⟨(I,s.val.2),⟨hb,hDb⟩⟩ : Atom)).1 w.val
      rw [hsb]
      exact hps
    have hqw := (spec.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 K w hpt' hps').1
    let B := BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J
    let z : B.Hom H K := B.comp (B.inv q) w
    have hz : z.val = q.val⁻¹ * w.val := rfl
    obtain ⟨ez⟩ := (StandardFactorCount cs J H K z).1
    have hmul : q.val * z.val = w.val := by rw [hz]; exact mul_inv_cancel_left _ _
    have hlen : cs.length w.val = cs.length q.val + cs.length z.val := by
      rw [hz]; exact hqw
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := cat H q z ea ez hmul hlen
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := cat H q z eb ez hmul hlen
    obtain ⟨ta, hea⟩ := spec.2.2.2.2.2.1
    obtain ⟨tb, heb⟩ := spec.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    change ea.val = (⟨(I, t.val.2), ⟨ha, hDa⟩⟩ : Atom) :: ta at hea
    have hea' : ea.val = t :: ta := Eq.trans hea (congrArg (fun x : Atom => x :: ta) hta)
    change eb.val = (⟨(I, s.val.2), ⟨hb, hDb⟩⟩ : Atom) :: tb at heb
    have heb' : eb.val = s :: tb := Eq.trans heb (congrArg (fun x : Atom => x :: tb) hsb)
    refine ⟨g, h, ta ++ ez.val, tb ++ ez.val, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hg, hea']; rfl
    · rw [hh, heb']; rfl
    · refine ⟨[], ea.val, eb.val, ez.val, ?_, ?_, ?_, I, K, g.property.1, h.property.1⟩
      · refine ⟨I, t.val.2, s.val.2, ha, hb, hab, hfin, ?_⟩
        exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact hg
      · exact hh
  
  let Moves := Relation.ReflTransGen (AtomicBraidRelations cs J)
  have moveSymm (xs ys : List Atom) (h : AtomicBraidRelations cs J xs ys) :
      AtomicBraidRelations cs J ys xs := by
    obtain ⟨pre, u, v, post, hb, hx, hy, L, H, hc, hd⟩ := h
    refine ⟨pre, v, u, post, ?_, hy, hx, L, H, hd, hc⟩
    obtain ⟨L, a, b, ha, hb, hab, hfin, hp⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨L, a, b, ha, hb, hab, hfin, ?_⟩
    rcases hp with ⟨hu, hv⟩ | ⟨hu, hv⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hv, hu⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hv, hu⟩
  have movesSymm {xs ys : List Atom} (h : Moves xs ys) : Moves ys xs := by
    induction h with
    | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | tail h hs ih => exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single (moveSymm _ _ hs)).trans ih
  /- Portal steps 1.1, 2.1, 4.1 and 5.1. Strong induction includes the
     one-factor case; no separate uniqueness assertion for it is needed.
     The measure is the common factor count, supplied by the proved corollary. -/
  have induction : ∀ n : Nat, ∀ (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
      (e f : StandardExpressions cs J I K w), e.val.length = n → Moves e.val f.val := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | ind n ih =>
      intro I K w e f hn
      have hcount := (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K w e f
      by_cases he0 : e.val = []
      · have hf0 : f.val = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by rw [← hcount, he0]; rfl)
        rw [he0, hf0]
      obtain ⟨t, es, he⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil he0
      have hf0 : f.val ≠ [] := by
        intro hf
        rw [he, hf] at hcount
        simp at hcount
      obtain ⟨s, fs, hf⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hf0
      have sameHeadConnect : ∀ (e f : StandardExpressions cs J I K w)
          (t : Atom) (es fs : List Atom), e.val = t :: es → f.val = t :: fs →
          e.val.length = n → Moves e.val f.val := by
        intro e f t es fs he hf hne
        obtain ⟨L, z, ez, fz, hez, hfz⟩ := same_head I K w e f t es fs he hf
        have hlt : es.length < n := by rw [he] at hne; simp only [List.length_cons] at hne; omega
        have hchain := ih es.length hlt L K z ez fz (congrArg List.length hez)
        rw [hez, hfz] at hchain
        have hc : Comp (t :: es) I.val K.val := he ▸ e.property.1
        have h := liftHead I K t es fs hc hchain
        simpa only [he, hf] using h
      by_cases hidx : t.val.2 = s.val.2
      · have ht := (head_prefix I K w e t es he).1
        have hs := (head_prefix I K w f s fs hf).1
        have hts : t = s := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (ht.symm.trans hs) hidx)
        subst s
        exact sameHeadConnect e f t es fs he hf hn
      · have ht := head_prefix I K w e t es he
        have hs := head_prefix I K w f s fs hf
        have ha : t.val.2 ∉ I.val := by rw [ht.1]; exact t.property.1
        have hb : s.val.2 ∉ I.val := by rw [hs.1]; exact s.property.1
        have hDa : Finite (cs.parabolic (component I.val t.val.2)) := by rw [ht.1]; exact t.property.2
        have hDb : Finite (cs.parabolic (component I.val s.val.2)) := by rw [hs.1]; exact s.property.2
